name: Mouana Mai Khao
shortDescription: Modern 3 and 4 bedroom private pool villas near Mai Khao Beach, by Mouana Phuket.
description:
Mouana Mai Khao is a private pool villa development near Mai Khao Beach by Mouana Phuket, offering 3 and 4 bedroom villas in a modern design. Some agents list it as Mouana Breeze Mai Khao or Mouana Maikhao; these appear to be the same project.

Mouana Phuket also builds Mouana Serenity Cherng Talay, which is a separate project listed elsewhere on this site.

Agent prices range from about 20 to 33 million baht and have moved over time, and completion is quoted from 2025 to Q3 2027, so we show neither. Message us on WhatsApp for the current price list and handover date.
